dedupe_keys.name: simulation data for three dimensional modeling of deep borehole heat exchanger arrays

description: Collin Wittenstein at Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz publishes temperature-field outputs for a three-dimensional deep-borehole heat-exchanger study. The free Zenodo release uses the MIT licence and supplies JLD2 files with saved temperatures and grid or geometry metadata, partly grouped into ZIP archives. Validation, depth-scaling and two-by-two and three-by-three array studies are identified. These outputs can benchmark thermal interference and heat-extraction simulations without rerunning the original expensive calculations. Related G6 models model-geothermalwells-julia and model-deep-borehole-array-thesis-experiments provide the solver and experiment setup. Coverage is numerical case studies, not observed operation at an installed geothermal field. The analysis repository pins GeothermalWells.jl 0.3.1 and requires a specific directory layout. Grid resolution and scenario assumptions vary by case, and numerical agreement claims remain unverified. No result archive was downloaded, Julia environment installed or temperature field reproduced.
